text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Yamanin Zephyr asked her 
classmate, Tokai Teio, about her goals 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—With a sensational run, the "Emperor" 
Symboli Rudolf claimed victory in the 
Japan Derby. I want to become an 
undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume just 
like her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Yamanin Zephyr looks up to the 
"Emperor of the Mile." Even if their idols 
differ, as fellow souls who hold deep 
admiration, they understand each other's 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is on the Mile route, while 
Tokai Teio is on the Triple Crown route. 
Though their paths differ, she got fired 
up, determined not to be left behind.
